model.description: Sweetgrass Botanicals GoodNight Hash Caps combine 100mg of THC and CBN in convenient capsule form for those seeking deep relaxation and restful sleep. This edible features hash-infused capsules designed to deliver calming, sedative effects that help you unwind after a long day. CBN, known for its sleep-promoting properties, works synergistically with THC to create a powerful nighttime formula. Each capsule offers precise dosing and discreet consumption without any taste or smell. Ideal for users looking for relief from restlessness and stress, GoodNight Hash Caps provide long-lasting effects that promote tranquility and sleepiness. Simply take as directed before bedtime and let Sweetgrass Botanicals guide you into a peaceful night's rest. Perfect for experienced cannabis users seeking a potent, reliable sleep aid in easy-to-swallow capsule format.
